//: The live demo. Tracker is the synthetic Jira project DEMO; DEMO-* tickets resolve to this team by project key. Releases come from GitHub tags on NjAIAgents/njagents-demo-app. Metrics come from Grafana Cloud Loki (history, heartbeats) and Vercel (deploys, runtime logs). Code is off until GitHub code search works for the repo; warehouse is off until provisioned. Every ticket, log line and deploy is synthetic.

tracker.name: Demo app
tracker.//component_model: This team-managed project has no components configured. Components are carried as labels of the form component-<name>. Treat a component-* label as the component when scoping history and duplicate search, so the counts stay area-scoped rather than project-wide.

metrics.//: Grafana Cloud Loki (grafanacloud-fondlizard977-logs), seeded by njagents-demo-app/seed/seed_grafana.py. Proven 2026-09-23: approvals-api 'approval not committed' ~12/h then ~53/h from 2026-09-19 01:00 UTC; deploy 2026.09 at 2026-09-16 21:00 UTC; settlement exports stop after 2026-09-20. Read-only queries only. Deploys and live runtime logs also come from Vercel project njagents-demo-app.

deploys.//: Production deployments carry the release as meta.githubCommitRef (2026.08, 2026.09). Runtime logs per deployment: 'approval commit failed' on 2026.08, 'approval not committed' on 2026.09.

warehouse.//: Warehouse not provisioned yet, Neon planned. Blast radius will be reported as unknown.

code.//: Search first; when search returns nothing, the file-read fallback reads files under key_paths (GitHub code search did not return repo-scoped results for this repo on 2026-09-23, file reads do).

release_correlation.//: vcs_tag reads the real 2026.08 and 2026.09 tags and the commits between them from GitHub, which gives files_touched. manual_file stays as a fallback; the merge rule matches releases on version. Vercel's 2026.09 production deploy was built from main at 8c32c8b, not the tag commit 919f499; approvals-api/ and core-api/ are identical between them (only api/, docs/, seed/ were added), so the tag's file list is what runs.

output.//run_trace: Safe to publish here because every ticket in DEMO is synthetic. A team whose tracker holds real customer tickets should leave this at the 'file' default.

links.//: Used only when a tool returns no URL. Code links pin to a commit when one is known.
